title: Zells shin measurements
$comment: Variable names CONFIRMED 2026-07-02 against the Onshape model's variable table (S1_ISW..S4_OD plus Leg_Length). Slices S1-S4 sit at 20/40/60/80 percent of Leg_Length measured up from the bottom of the ankle; Leg_Length runs from the bottom of the ankle to the knee. All values are millimeters. Renames now require a coordinated schema version bump across TS, Python, and the Onshape model.

Leg_Length.description: Total leg length from the bottom of the ankle to the knee, in millimeters.

S1_ISW.description: Inner shin width at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S1_ISD.description: Inner shin depth at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S1_ICW.description: Inner calf width at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S1_ICD.description: Inner calf depth at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S1_OW.description: Outer width at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S1_OD.description: Outer depth at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.

S2_ISW.description: Inner shin width at slice S2 (40 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters.
